name: Impact additionality (evidence of contribution to solution)

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.32-4.38 — Sustainability Impact requires the asset to contribute to the solution, distinct from already-sustainable assets)

summary: Tests whether evidence is provided that the asset materially contributes to the named impact objective — the additionality test. PS23/16 ¶4.35 requires the contribution to be 'material' and 'attributable'. PB methodology v3.5 aligned band requires explicit additionality evidence: would this outcome have happened without this asset/financing? Acceptable forms include written additionality narrative referencing the counterfactual, sustainability-linked capital structure that ties cost-of-capital to outcome achievement, or evidence that the asset enables a step-change in sector performance (e.g. PUE materially below sector median in an underserved climate zone).
